name: Kyonyuu Maid Nakadashi Tengoku!
original_name: 巨乳メイド 中出し天国！
source:
You're our hero, returning home after an average day. As you casually glance up, you notice the light is on in your empty apartment... Did you forget to turn it off, or... is it a burglar?! You nervously open the door...

"Welcome home, Master!"

There's a girl waiting for you that you've never seen before... and a cute maid, at that! And if that wasn't surprising enough, this is what she blurts out next!

"Please... become my Master!!"

You don't have a clue what's going on, but you figure... what the heck!

"I'll do anything for Master... ♪"

Her virginity is yours for the taking! And you don't have to think twice about cumming inside! Sit back and relax as your own personal maid takes care of your every desire... and we do mean each and every one!

translation:
你就是本作的主人公。结束平凡的一天回到家时，你无意间抬头一瞥，发现本该空无一人的公寓里竟然亮着灯……是忘了关灯，还是……进了小偷！？你提心吊胆地推开房门……

“欢迎回来，主人！”

屋里竟有一名素未谋面的少女在等着你……而且还是一位可爱的女仆！如果这还不够令人吃惊，她接下来脱口而出的话更是石破天惊：

“请……成为我的主人吧！！”

你完全摸不着头脑，但转念一想……管他呢！

“只要是主人的吩咐，我什么都愿意做……♪”

她的纯洁初夜任你采撷，内射也完全无须顾忌！尽管放松享受，让这位专属女仆满足你的一切欲望……没错，真的是每一种欲望！
